opening.argument: The offer is framed around mining with the promoter in exchange for substantially more Bitcoin: viewers are told they will “probably have between 2 and 8 times more bitcoin.” That favorable return claim is paired with emphatic assurances that it is “working for 100% of the members” and a direct urging not to stay out. The description reinforces the sales pitch, calling mining “the most profitable business of 2017” and directing viewers to contact the promoter. Together, these statements present paid mining as a route to exceptional Bitcoin gains and press viewers to participate, supporting the conclusion that this is a scam involving promised mining returns.
